description: Poll the OpenTrain delta feed of account events (new proposals, proposal status changes, new messages, contracts, milestone changes, pending payments) in one cheap call instead of re-reading every resource. Pass the nextCursor from the previous poll to receive only newer events; payloads carry IDs only — fetch details with the matching read tool. Event visibility follows the token scopes (proposals:read, messages:read, payments:read).

cursor.description: Last event id already processed (nextCursor from the previous poll). Omit on the first poll.

name: opentrain_poll_updates
